pins.title: White Noise Machine for Apartment Noise: Which Sound Is Keeping You Up?
pins.subtitle: Voices, traffic, or footsteps?
pins.description: It's 1 a.m. and the neighbors are still talking. Before you buy a white noise machine for apartment noise, work out which sound is keeping you up. A machine doesn't remove sound. It adds a steady one that may make voices less noticeable. For traffic, earplugs may be the better first try. Footsteps are the hard case. Not medical advice. Read the full guide. #whitenoisemachine #apartmentnoise #apartmentliving #soundmachine #noisyneighbors #sleepsetup

pins.title: White Noise Machine vs Earplugs for Apartment Noise: Mask or Block?
pins.subtitle: Two opposite approaches
pins.description: White noise machine or earplugs for loud neighbors? A machine masks: it adds a steady sound and leaves your ears free, but it may reach the neighbors. Earplugs block: they reduce the sound reaching your ear, but need a good fit and can dull an alarm. We compare LectroFan EVO, Yogasleep Dohm Classic, Loop Dream, and Mack's Ultra Soft. Not medical advice. See the full comparison. #whitenoisemachine #earplugs #apartmentnoise #noisyneighbors #sleepsetup

pins.title: White Noise for Footsteps From Upstairs: What to Know Before You Buy
pins.subtitle: Be cautious with big promises
pins.description: Hoping white noise will cover footsteps from upstairs? Don't count on it. We haven't found published research confirming that it does. Footsteps may be felt as vibration, low sounds may be harder to cover, and earplugs can't do much about vibration. Be cautious about any listing that says otherwise. Not medical advice. Read the guide before you buy. #whitenoise #upstairsneighbors #apartmentnoise #apartmentliving #soundmachine

pins.title: White Noise Machine in an Apartment: 5-Point Bedroom Test Checklist
pins.subtitle: One night won't tell you much
pins.description: Save this checklist for testing a white noise machine in your apartment. 1) Start at the lowest volume that helps. 2) Move it around and compare. 3) Give each sound a few nights. 4) Write down what still gets through. 5) Check whether your sound is reaching the neighbors. Also check that you can still hear your smoke alarm. Not medical advice. Full checklist in the guide. #whitenoisemachine #soundmachine #apartmentliving #bedroomchecklist #sleepsetup
